title: Keto German Slider
description: A keto version of a classic German burger, using a dense meat patty and topped with fresh ingredients.

ingredients.name: Burger Bun (low-carb)
ingredients.notes: made from almond flour or coconut flour

instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. Form the ground beef into 4 equal-sized patties.
3. Season the patties with salt and pepper.
4. Grill the patties for 4-5 minutes per side, or until they reach an internal temperature of 160°F.
5. Meanwhile, toast the buns on the grill or in a toaster.
6. Assemble the sliders by spreading mayonnaise and mustard on the bottom bun, followed by a lettuce leaf, a cheese slice, a beef patty, a tomato slice, and finally the top bun.
